Projects

  • QuestPass

    Founder · full-stack · Devcon 8. An event engagement platform launched at Devcon 8 Mumbai: 65+ attendee passes from 30+ cities and 138 side events and stamp spots. QR connect with consent-based contact sharing, a filterable People directory, organiser event submissions with Luma and CSV imports, and an NFC stamp hunt with a leaderboard. Its photo booth has since been integrated and used by PizzaDAO at its events. Built with: TypeScript, Docker, Google Cloud, Cloudflare Tunnel, NFC, Claude Code.

  • Thermo

    macOS app · Open source. A free Mac app that shows CPU, GPU, SSD and battery temperatures around the notch and tells you which app is heating your Mac, what's slowing down and what to close. Memory, battery-health and 24-hour history tabs, smart alerts, and no sudo or kernel extensions. Built with: Swift, macOS, Homebrew, AI-agent API.

  • shipcrate

    Open source · Release tooling. Release and update tooling in one command: a quality gate with git hooks and CI, GitHub releases with SHA-256 checksums and provenance, a Homebrew formula, a verifying installer and update notices. Extracted from Thermo, with a Claude Code plugin and an MCP server for AI agents. Built with: POSIX shell, GitHub Actions, Homebrew, MCP.

  • makereel

    Open source · Video. Turns live streams and long videos into captioned 9:16 reels on your own computer: clips YouTube, Twitch and Kick streams live from loudness and chat spikes, word-by-word Hindi, English and Hinglish captions, speaker framing and creator credits. No account or API key needed. Built with: Python, FFmpeg, yt-dlp, faster-whisper.

  • Model Shelf (msh)

    Rust CLI · In progress. One local library for every AI model on a Mac: finds duplicate model files across Ollama, LM Studio and Hugging Face by SHA-256 and links them instead of copying, with undo. Built with: Rust, CLI, Ollama, LM Studio, Hugging Face.

  • SuiSips

    Next.js · Client build. A production SIP tracker and community platform for the Sui ecosystem: proposals synced from GitHub, discussions, articles, videos and a curated tweet wall. Built with Next.js, React Markdown and Tailwind CSS.

  • Miden SDK Simulator

    React · Miden SDK. An interactive demo of anonymous, privacy-preserving voting on Miden's ZK rollup SDK. Scoped, built and shipped with no prior Miden experience, to show how any new SDK becomes learnable through a working demo.

  • JSON API Visualizer

    Next.js · Live tool. Fetch any public REST API and explore the response as an interactive graph and tree. Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and v0.

  • Etherlink Project Showcase

    Etherlink · GitHub. A showcase repo spotlighting dApps built on Tezos and Etherlink after hackathons, alongside demo apps for workshop attendees.

  • Gitfund

    Web3 · OSS. Auto-pays open-source contributors for merged PRs using programmable smart-contract logic.

  • OverWatch TS

    Open source. Built the initial example template for overwatch-ts, a lightweight state-management library for Next.js.

  • Virtual Tweet Gallery

    Community tool. The W3EventGallery bot collects event tweets into a shared gallery of memories.

  • German → English Translator

    ML. A Seq2Seq-with-attention tutorial implementation for German-to-English translation.

  • Face Detection & Recognition

    OpenCV. Haar-cascade face and eye detection that can also save and recognise faces by name.
